```{r data}
Size_Idx <- read_rds("data/Monthly_Index_Constituents.rds")
Stocks <- read_rds("data/Stock_Returns_Daily.rds")
Idx_Daily <-
  read_rds("data/Index_Returns_Daily.rds") %>%
  filter(Tickers %in% c("J200", "J201", "J202", "J433"))

# Rescale weights to sum to one per index and month
Size_Clean <-
  Size_Idx %>%
  group_by(Fund, date) %>%
  mutate(Weight = Weight / sum(Weight)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

# Sector Exposure and Concentration \label{Comp}

```{r sector, fig.cap = "Sector exposure by index \\label{fig:sector}", fig.height = 5}
g_sector <-
Size_Clean %>%
ggplot() +
geom_bar(aes(date, Weight, fill = Sector), stat = "identity") +
facet_wrap(~Fund) +
labs(title = "Sector Exposure by Index",
subtitle = "Monthly constituent weights grouped by sector",
x = "Year", y = "Sector weight") +
fmxdat::theme_fmx() + fmxdat::fmx_fills()

fmxdat::finplot(g_sector, y.pct = T, y.pct_acc = 1)
```

```{r conc, fig.cap = "Weight of the ten largest stocks in each index \\label{fig:conc}", fig.height = 4}
Conc <-
Size_Clean %>%
group_by(Fund, date) %>%
arrange(desc(Weight)) %>%
top_n(10, Weight) %>%
summarise(Top10 = sum(Weight))

g_conc <-
Conc %>%
ggplot() +
geom_line(aes(date, Top10, color = Fund), alpha = 0.8) +
labs(title = "Top 10 Stock Concentration",
subtitle = "Combined weight of the ten largest stocks in each index",
x = "Year", y = "Weight of top 10 stocks") +
fmxdat::theme_fmx() + fmxdat::fmx_cols()

fmxdat::finplot(g_conc, y.pct = T, y.pct_acc = 1)
```


# Volatility \label{Vol}

```{r cons_vol, fig.cap = "Rolling one year realised volatility of index constituents \\label{fig:consvol}", fig.height = 4}

Cons_Vol <- Q2_Cons_Vol(Stocks, Size_Clean, Window = 252)

g_consvol <-
  Cons_Vol %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(date, RollSD, color = Fund), alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(title = "Realised Volatility of Index Constituents",
       subtitle = "Rolling 1 year standard deviation, annualised (weighted by index weight)",
       x = "Year", y = "Annualised SD") +
  fmxdat::theme_fmx() + fmxdat::fmx_cols()

fmxdat::finplot(g_consvol, y.pct = T, y.pct_acc = 1)
```

```{r strat, results = 'asis'}
# Daily index returns with the same labels as the constituent data
Idxs <-
  Idx_Daily %>%
  mutate(Fund = ifelse(Tickers == "J200", "LargeCaps",
                ifelse(Tickers == "J201", "MidCaps",
                ifelse(Tickers == "J202", "SmallCaps", "CappedSWIX")))) %>%
  select(date, Tickers = Fund, Return = Returns) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Return)) %>%
  mutate(YM = format(date, "%Y%B"))

# Monthly Capped SWIX volatility, split into high (above the 85th percentile), low (below the 25th) and other
SWIX_Vol <-
  Idxs %>%
  filter(Tickers == "CappedSWIX") %>%
  group_by(YM) %>% summarise(Value = sd(Return) * sqrt(252)) %>%
  Enviro_Split(Hi = 0.85, Lo = 0.25, Label = "volatility") %>%
  select(YM, Enviro)

# Annualised SD and return of each index in each environment
Strat_Tab <-
  left_join(Idxs, SWIX_Vol, by = "YM") %>%
  group_by(Enviro, Tickers) %>%
  summarise(SD = sd(Return) * sqrt(252), Ret = mean(Return) * 252) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(Index = Tickers)

print(xtable(Strat_Tab, caption = "Annualised return and SD by Capped SWIX volatility environment \\label{tab:strat}", digits = 3),
      floating = TRUE, table.placement = 'H', comment = FALSE,
      caption.placement = 'bottom', include.rownames = FALSE)
```

# Returns \label{Ret}

```{r roll_rets, fig.cap = "Rolling three year annualised returns \\label{fig:rollrets}", fig.height = 4}

# Monthly returns of the size indexes and the Capped SWIX, with the same labels as the constituent data
Idx_Monthly <-
  Idx_Daily %>%
  filter(Tickers %in% c("J200", "J201", "J202", "J433")) %>%
  Daily_to_Monthly() %>%
  mutate(Fund = ifelse(Tickers == "J200", "LargeCaps",
                ifelse(Tickers == "J201", "MidCaps",
                ifelse(Tickers == "J202", "SmallCaps", "CappedSWIX"))))

# Rolling 3 year annualised returns
Roll_Rets <-
  Idx_Monthly %>%
  group_by(Fund) %>%
  mutate(RollRets = RcppRoll::roll_prod(1 + Ret, 36, fill = NA, align = "right") ^ (12/36) - 1) %>%
  group_by(date) %>% filter(any(!is.na(RollRets))) %>%
  ungroup()

g_roll <-
  Roll_Rets %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(date, RollRets, color = Fund), alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(title = "Rolling 3 Year Annualised Returns",
       subtitle = "Size indexes compared to the Capped SWIX",
       x = "Year", y = "Rolling 3 year return (Ann.)") +
  fmxdat::theme_fmx() + fmxdat::fmx_cols()

fmxdat::finplot(g_roll, y.pct = T, y.pct_acc = 1)
```

# Active Share \label{AS}

```{r active_share, fig.cap = "Active share of each size index relative to the Capped SWIX \\label{fig:as}", fig.height = 4}
# Weights of every stock in all four indexes side by side (0 if a stock is not in that index)
Wide_W <-
  Size_Clean %>%
  select(date, Tickers, Fund,Weight) %>%
  spread(Fund, Weight, fill = 0)

# Half the sum of absolute weight differences from the Capped SWIX, per index per month
Active_Share <-
  Wide_W %>%
  gather(Fund, Weight, LargeCaps, MidCaps, SmallCaps) %>%
  group_by(date, Fund) %>%
  summarise(AS = 0.5 * sum(abs(Weight - CappedSWIX))) %>%
  ungroup()

g_as <-
  Active_Share %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_line(aes(date, AS, color = Fund), alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(title = "Active Share Relative to the Capped SWIX",
       subtitle = "Half the sum of absolute weight differences from the Capped SWIX",
       x = "Year", y = "Active share") +
  fmxdat::theme_fmx() + fmxdat::fmx_cols()

fmxdat::finplot(g_as, y.pct = T, y.pct_acc = 1)
```

```{r stats, results = 'asis'}
Tab_stats <-
  bind_rows(
    Moments_Comp(Idx_Monthly %>% select(date, Tickers, Ret), BM = "J433", Yrs_LookBack = 3, NA_Check = 0.8),
    Moments_Comp(Idx_Monthly %>% select(date, Tickers, Ret), BM = "J433", Yrs_LookBack = 5, NA_Check = 0.8)
  ) %>%
  # Same labels as the rest of the report
  rename(LargeCaps = J200, MidCaps = J201, SmallCaps = J202, CappedSWIX = J433)

print(xtable(Tab_stats, caption = "Risk and return statistics of the size indexes relative to the Capped SWIX \\label{tab:stats}", digits = 3),
      floating = TRUE, table.placement = 'H', comment = FALSE,
      caption.placement = 'bottom', include.rownames = FALSE, size = "\\footnotesize")
```
